title: Course Schedule
description: There are `numCourses` courses labeled 0..n-1 and a list of prerequisite pairs. Return true if all courses can be finished (i.e. the prerequisite graph has no cycle), otherwise false.

hints.text: Model courses and prerequisites as a directed graph; a cycle means the schedule is impossible.
Detect a cycle with depth-first search using three node colors: unvisited, in progress, done.
If DFS reaches a node that is still in progress, a back edge (cycle) exists.
